items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: The name 'Daniel' appears only in the interviewer's turn ('Well at the time Daniel, let me') as a form of address or filler. The interviewee does not mention Daniel, nor does he respond to any specific question about a person named Daniel. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relations

ctx.x: Who was some of the violin players? Well, I could remember a good old man Robichaux and Peter Bucker and a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was and Peter Bocard and Jimmy Pollard. Well they had many more other violin players, I didn't know it, I think. Yeah. Yeah, I didn't know it. Who did Peter Bocard play with? Well Peter was, they had a band, the Superior Band, you understand, him and Bunk Johnson. Did you see the picture of Watson? Yeah,…

Mmhmm. One time I was talking to Joe Robichaux and he says he saw Big Eye Lewis with his dad, his uncle's band, and he said he didn't know that Big Eye wasn't any musician, he thought Big Eye was reading all those poets and he just faked them. Well at the time Daniel, let me

take the time, see Big, he meets every fellow there, you see, he gets with a bunch of musicians like that, and he can play something there, the music, you understand? You can disqualify that, know what I mean? Mmhmm. You can disqualify them, you understand? Then you meet the fellow there, what can know the music, and get there and he can't play it. Yeah. You understand? You see? And it's supposed to keep that fellow there, what you know good and well, he got to do what you're trying to do, and you got to…
